format.name: DeploySharpReleaseEvidence
format.conclusion: A validated DeploySharp-specific provenance/SBOM document; it does not claim SPDX or CycloneDX conformance.

ownershipScopes.name: deploysharp-package
ownershipScopes.rule: Only DeploySharp managed DLL/XML payload and nuspec dependencies are shipped.

ownershipScopes.name: managed-dependency
ownershipScopes.rule: Resolved managed package dependencies are recorded from lock/assets and local NuGet metadata.

ownershipScopes.name: consumer-owned-native-runtime
ownershipScopes.rule: Optional native runtime packages are selected and licensed by the consumer and are absent from DeploySharp package dependencies/payload.

ownershipScopes.name: external-model
ownershipScopes.rule: Model license and redistribution state are independent from NuGet package/runtime licenses.

modelLicenses.releaseBlocker: Local-only authorization does not grant publication or official catalog admission.
